$comment: Round 5A Architecture Reset — specification schema version 1.0.0. Schemas only; registries and schema-9 implementation are out of scope for Phase A.
title: Round 5A Architecture Reset Registry Schema
description: Composite authoritative JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for Round 5A machine-readable registry artifacts. Validates JSON documents and YAML documents after YAML-to-JSON-compatible parsing. Ambiguity that previously blocked findings #2/#4/#5 is made structurally invalid.
x-round5a-invariants: Exactly 18 unique checkpoint_id values in every checkpoint_registry.
No duplicate checkpoint names in a checkpoint_registry.
All referenced QUERY-* / PRIMITIVE-* identifiers exist in the shared catalog/primitive model.
No OID, object_oid, relation_oid, function_oid, row_number, physical_location, or ctid (including case variants and nested uses) may appear in identity or digest input fields.
Every digest.input_contract field name exists in selected_fields with digest_included=true.
Every ordering.fields entry exists in selected_fields.
Bidirectional validation slots are complete for every checkpoint entry.
Exactly 22 unique rule_id values in every reconciliation_rule_registry.
Rule order values are exactly the contiguous set 1..22.
Exactly one fallback rule; it must be order 22 with is_fallback=true and failure_state=failed_frozen.
Non-fallback rules must set is_fallback=false.
Every decisive_fields entry appears in the rule predicate AST.
Every explicit_exclusions entry is a typed AST or typed field/identity reference — never prose.
Every referenced field exists in the shared reconciliation data model.
Every rule has fixture coverage in a reconciliation_fixture_pack.
All 231 earlier/later rule pairs (C(22,2)) are evaluated by the Phase D validator for shadowing/reachability.
Fallback is reachable; no rule is unreachable under the declared domain.
Every bounded fixture source maps to exactly one outcome slot.
Role discovery mode must be CATALOG_DISCOVERY; fixed named role lists are never the sole discovery mechanism.
Column ACL semantics must declare NULL attacl meaning, table-privilege independence, and acldefault('c') prohibition.
Permitted variance requires at least one ND-* decision_refs entry.
LIVE_CATALOG evidence_class requires an explicit runtime evidence reference.
Cross-file $ref / artifact reference validity is enforced by Phase D (JSON Schema alone cannot prove it).
Generated Markdown is never normative when it differs from a registry.

schema_version.description: Specification schema version. Breaking changes require a major version increment.

ascii_upper_id_segment.description: Uppercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens only. Stable across generated documentation. Never a database OID or row number.

ckp_id.description: Checkpoint registry entry identifier (CKP-* form). Distinct from checkpoint_id slug used in runtime rows.

query_id.description: Versioned typed query/selector primitive identifier. Not unrestricted SQL text.

sha256_hex.description: Literal SHA-256 digest as lowercase hex. Not an instruction to call production digest code.

iso8601_timestamp.description: Metadata timestamp only; must be excluded from normative digests.

unstable_identity_field_name.description: Prohibited identity/digest field names. Phase D also rejects case variants and nested uses.

stable_field_name.description: Stable field name. OIDs and physical locators are prohibited.

runtime_evidence_ref.description: Required when evidence_class is LIVE_CATALOG (Phase D enforces).

natural_identity.description: OID-free natural identity. Validator rejects unstable fields including case variants and nested uses.

null_semantics.description: Explicit null semantics. Implicit SQL three-valued logic is prohibited.

operand.description: Closed operand set. Arbitrary SQL, Python, shell, templates, and eval are prohibited.

predicate_node.description: Restricted reconciliation predicate AST. No arbitrary SQL, Python, shell, template expressions, or eval.

decision_refs.description: Permitted variance requires at least one ND-* reference.

mode.description: Dynamic role discovery is mandatory. A fixed role list is never the sole discovery mechanism.

required_roles.description: Supplementary named roles. Never replaces CATALOG_DISCOVERY.

table_privileges_independently_authorita.description: Table privileges remain independently authoritative when attacl is NULL.

acldefault_column_prohibited.description: acldefault('c', ...) is prohibited for column ACL interpretation.

acl_resolution.description: acldefault('r', owner) when ACL is absent.
acldefault('s', owner) when ACL is absent.

privilege_paths.description: Must include all eight privilege-path dimensions.

primitive_ref.description: Versioned typed primitive/query reference. Unrestricted SQL text is prohibited.

selected_field.description: Unstable fields may appear only when digest_included=false; identity prohibition still applies via Phase D.

checkpoint_id.description: Stable checkpoint slug (e.g. crypto_schema_complete). Registry may also carry CKP-* via optional ckp_ref.

baseline_predicate.description: Optional baseline (pre-state) predicate; required by Phase D for CP-01 split.

post_state_predicate.description: Optional post-state predicate; required by Phase D for CP-01 split.

operation.description: Typed operation identifier. Prose-only actions are prohibited.

source_identity_ref.description: Multiple source identities may reference one event; exactly one outcome slot per source identity (Phase D).

canonical_bytes.description: Literal canonical byte sequence encoding (e.g. UTF-8 text or hex-prefixed bytes). Not a production-code call.

expected_digest.description: Literal expected digest. Production digest functions must never self-oracle.

raw_acl.description: Literal ACL text or null. NULL semantics differ by object kind per catalog contract.

generated_at.description: Metadata only; excluded from normative digests.
